name: bandit.phase4_local_zombie_monmove_return_mcw
description: Source-bound Phase-4 proof route for a local pair that learns only one ordinary visible on-route zombie through its own monmove observation. The inherited fixture starts with an idle five-member camp and no staged monster. Production first dispatches and commits its exact pair. Only after the two-member local-owner audit does the disposable run teleport the passive avatar to the recorded route OMT and stage one hostile mon_zombie one tile east. Bounded ordinary turns must emit the identity-bound local-zombie receipt, transition safely home, consume ordered physical receipts, and apply the returned dangerous lead. The avatar is not a threat source and no unseen-monster or avatar fact is admissible.
artifact_patterns: bandit_live_world local physical return receipt committed

evidence_contract.claim: only the accepted live scouting observer learns the one ordinary visible on-route zombie; the returned dangerous lead is produced after the two exact physical receipts and never from avatar or unseen-zombie state
evidence_contract.runtime_provenance: a future run must bind the current worktree source, current executable, resolved source fixture chain, profile snapshot, same-run debug artifact, native save/writeback, accepted cleanup, and registry-owned canonical probe report
evidence_contract.canonical_ingestion_gate: no declared capability becomes run-verified until a fresh typed registry query, selected registry-launch, and canonical report ingestion show every named terminal gate green under compatible runtime, fixture, and profile bindings
evidence_contract.finalizer: the native save/writeback gates precede the registry-launch finalizer; the registry alone ingests the finalized probe report after accepted cleanup
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a missing source-bound fixture chain, incomplete two-member handoff, absent accepted receipt, avatar/hidden truth token, unordered physical receipt, missing native writeback, or non-dangerous returned lead is red or blocked; startup alone is never feature proof
